profile.purpose: Track target work platforms; do not infer access or permission from a platform name.

platforms.name: Atlas Capture
platforms.notes: Official site reviewed. Consumer capture tasks require an iPhone 11 or newer and task availability/pay vary by country. The standard consumer recording workflow requires a supported iPhone; verify device compatibility and country availability before spending money or attempting signup. Recording must be genuine and human-performed; do not automate task recording or submissions.

platforms.name: Clickworker
platforms.notes: Do not automate account activity unless current official terms and task rules explicitly permit it.

platforms.name: Microworkers
platforms.notes: Keep logged-in work manual unless current official rules explicitly permit a specific integration.

platforms.name: RapidWorkers
platforms.notes: Domain supplied by user. Verify current terms, operator identity, payment rules and task eligibility before any account connection.

platforms.name: SproutGigs
platforms.notes: Treat as manual-only until current official policy confirms otherwise.

platforms.name: AfterQuery
platforms.notes: Experts portal identity confirmed. Public listings include remote expert contracts, including a Content Writer and Evaluator - Global listing; requirements, pay, work location, weekly commitment and payout method vary by role. Applications, assessments, identity checks, contract acceptance and work submissions remain human-reviewed.

platforms.name: Handshake AI
platforms.notes: Confirm the exact Handshake AI service; do not assume it is the same as the Handshake student recruiting platform.

platforms.name: Braintrust
platforms.notes: User supplied the official Talent dashboard URL. Braintrust's current Terms list restricted territories (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria and specified Ukrainian regions); Kenya is not named in that list, but account eligibility and role-specific country restrictions still need confirmation. Profile must be truthful; ID/location and financial-account verification may be requested. Treat Braintrust as a vetted professional talent marketplace, not a generic microtask site. Current public talent page describes AI skills interview and certification; profile creation and application remain human-reviewed. Verify Kenya payout method in the account before investing significant time.

platforms.name: OpenTrain AI
platforms.notes: Public discovery uses the documented anonymous GET https://app.opentrain.ai/api/public/v1/jobs (no key; documented 120 requests/minute/IP limit). A job's eligible countries are set by the employer and are separate from OpenTrain's payout-country list (Kenya is on the payout list as of 2026-11-08). An empty country list is never treated as Kenya-eligible. Applications, AI interviews, location checks and contracts remain human-performed.

platforms.name: GainWorkers
platforms.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-08. Task listings are behind login (/jobs redirects to /login; robots.txt disallows /jobs/ and other work areas). The Terms of Service prohibit scraping and bots and VPN/proxy use to bypass geo rules. The documented API (/api/v2) is an employer/SMM-reseller API (services, orders, wallet) and is not a worker-task discovery API, so it is not used. Review tasks manually in your own signed-in session; optionally record them in data/manual/gainworkers_tasks.json for scoring.

platforms.name: Mindrift
platforms.notes: Kenya is explicitly listed as not currently supported in https://mindrift.ai/legal/eligibility-and-geographic-restrictions (policy 'Last updated: May 27, 2026'; verified 2026-11-08). The registry keeps the platform but it is NOT counted as an active Kenya-eligible source. The eligibility monitor only flags policy changes for manual review; it never enables discovery automatically.

platforms.name: REWORKIO
platforms.notes: AI/automation expert marketplace (not a microtask site). /projects/ and /opportunities/ are client-rendered shells whose briefs load from an undocumented backend, and the dashboard needs sign-in, so no supported public discovery interface exists. Use the manual-review links. Treat any paid membership, deposit, escrow funding or other upfront cost as a stop-and-decide item; nothing is purchased or paid automatically.

platforms.name: UserTesting
platforms.notes: Participant eligibility is dynamic: UserTesting says it does not publish a fixed eligible-country list and the contributor sign-up flow determines whether a location can join. Kenya must be checked in the real signup flow; do not infer eligibility. Payments are in USD to a verified PayPal account, normally 14 days after completing a test, with no minimum payout. Windows applicants need Windows 10 64-bit or later, at least 8 GB RAM, 1920x1080 display, microphone and at least 5 Mbps upload; user laptop RAM, display resolution and upload speed still need checking.

platforms.name: User Interviews
platforms.notes: The current official participant country list does not include Kenya and says people in unlisted countries cannot yet participate in studies. Do not apply or attempt country workarounds while that policy remains. Some User Interviews-distributed incentives use Tremendous digital rewards; researcher-paid study incentives vary and may be selected by the researcher. Neither route overrides the country restriction.

platforms.name: Prolific
platforms.notes: Kenya is not in Prolific's current supported participant-country list. Unsupported-country users may join the waitlist, but access is not guaranteed; some may be invited. Eligibility is based on current residence, not nationality. Do not use a different country or VPN. Cashouts require PayPal and a combined approved balance of at least GBP 6 or USD 6; PayPal country must match current residence or country of birth under Prolific's rules.

platforms.name: PaidViewpoint
platforms.notes: PaidViewpoint says it operates in 50 countries but does not publish a fixed list; the registration flow asks the country and confirms whether signup can continue or a future-country email waitlist is available. Kenya eligibility must therefore be checked in the actual signup flow. It requires PayPal for cashout; first withdrawal threshold is USD 15, then USD 10 and USD 5 for subsequent withdrawals when the account remains in good standing. Official FAQ says processing is expected within 72 hours. Survey volume is not guaranteed and PaidViewpoint says it should not be considered a job or work-from-home opportunity.

platforms.name: Whop Workforce
platforms.notes: Whop Workforce is a Whop community/bounty destination, not a verified public worker-task API. Whop's current Terms prohibit automated access/monitoring such as robots, spiders and scrapers without written consent. Whop Earnings Terms describe seller-created bounties, participant proof submission and payment after seller approval; participants must be 18+ and in good standing. Kenya campaign eligibility and the user's available payout route must be checked in the actual account before relying on any bounty. Keep all review, task acceptance and submissions manual.
